name: HUNTINGTON 6 PERSON CANOPY BARREL SAUNA
description: The Huntington is one of Almost Heaven Sauna’s largest barrel saunas. It can fit up to 6 people comfortably. This sauna is perfect for those who want to use the sauna as a place to reconnect and socialize with others. It is also perfect for two individuals to stretch out and find a quiet oasis to sit back and enjoy the peacefulness of sauna. Whatever your preference, the Huntington sauna is the perfect sauna for you.
